To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• Deep geometric matrix completion is able to outperform the state-of-the-art in the matrix completion problem; • MGCNN and its variants can be applied to a wide range of problems, such as document classification or molecular property prediction; • The learnable diffusion process, which is a key component of the proposed approach, is able to capture the underlying structure of the data, which in turn leads to better performance.
Deep Geometric Matrix completion outperforms previous state of the arts on the matrix completion task.

1) Graph Convolutional Networks are a powerful tool for the matrix completion problem, 2) the combination of Graph Convolution with Recurrent Neural Networks can be used to model a learnable diffusion on the data, 3) MGCNN is able to outperform previous solutions on the matrix recovery task.
